CREATE TABLE `cl_monitor_config_pool_controls` (`family` tinyint NOT NULL,`pool_id` bigint NOT NULL,`reserved_generation` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,`current_attempt_operation_id` bigint unsigned,`last_committed_operation_id` bigint unsigned,`last_projected_operation_id` bigint unsigned,`created_at` datetime(3) NULL,`updated_at` datetime(3) NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`family`,`pool_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE `cl_monitor_config_pool_operations` (`operation_id` bigint unsigned AUTO_INCREMENT,`family` tinyint NOT NULL,`pool_id` bigint NOT NULL,`generation` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`nonce` binary(16) NOT NULL,`phase` varchar(16) NOT NULL,`source_hash` binary(32),`manifest` json,`recovery_of_operation_id` bigint unsigned,`failure_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',`created_at` datetime(3) NULL,`updated_at` datetime(3) NULL,`committed_at` datetime(3) NULL,`projected_at` datetime(3) NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`),UNIQUE INDEX `uk_config_pool_operation_nonce` (`nonce`),INDEX `idx_config_pool_operation_recovery` (`recovery_of_operation_id`),INDEX `idx_config_pool_operation_pending` (`phase`,`operation_id`),UNIQUE INDEX `uk_config_pool_operation_generation` (`family`,`pool_id`,`generation`)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE `cl_monitor_config_artifact_events` (`event_id` bigint unsigned AUTO_INCREMENT,`operation_id` bigint unsigned,`config_type` tinyint NOT NULL,`instance_key` varbinary(180) NOT NULL,`action` varchar(16) NOT NULL,`projection_policy` varchar(20) NOT NULL,`config_row_id` bigint,`old_owner_digest` binary(32),`new_owner_digest` binary(32),`body_digest` binary(32),`binding` json,`binding_event_id` bigint unsigned,`delivery_state` varchar(16) NOT NULL,`failure_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',`created_at` datetime(3) NULL,`updated_at` datetime(3) NULL,`projected_at` datetime(3) NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`event_id`),INDEX `idx_config_artifact_namespace` (`config_type`,`instance_key`,`event_id`),INDEX `idx_config_artifact_delivery` (`delivery_state`,`event_id`),INDEX `idx_config_artifact_operation` (`operation_id`,`event_id`),INDEX `idx_config_artifact_binding` (`binding_event_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB
